title: Cops Find Missing Mom in Her Son's Freezer
description:
Albuquerque police conducting a welfare check for missing 69-year-old Ernestina Lucero make a chilling discovery inside the home she shared with her son, Leroy Vallejos. Watch the investigation and interrogation unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
